# Rogue — finite-time blow-up & rogue-wave predictor

> Real-time physics-based extreme-wave forecast. Ocean, aerospace, plasma, fiber-optics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rogue.jesed.dev/): Project overview, why it exists, how to use, parameters, CLI instructions, instrument connections.
- [Education](https://rogue.jesed.dev/education): Interactive NLS simulation dashboard — Akhmediev breathers, Peregrine solitons, JONSWAP random seas, quintic blow-up.
- [Production](https://rogue.jesed.dev/production): Real sea-state input → physical NLS forecast. Rogue-wave detection from Hs, Tp, γ.
- [Docs](https://rogue.jesed.dev/docs): Full documentation — mathematics, architecture, CLI usage, production mode, instrument connections, web dashboard, download, contributing.

## Quick facts

- Built on Merle–Raphael–Rodnianski–Szeftel (2026) finite-time blow-up in supercritical defocusing NLS.
- Symplectic Strang split-step solver. Deterministic, seeded, reproducible.
- Rust core (9 crates) + WASM browser runtime (262 kB gzipped ~98 kB).
- MIT license. Free software. Source: https://github.com/jesedv/rogue
- Author: https://jesed.dev
